description: This source file contains unit tests for API endpoints related to employee workflow, specifically testing job title creation and access control using NUnit and RestSharp.

classes.name: ApiEmployeeWorkflowTests
classes.description: A sealed test class deriving from ApiTestBase that contains tests related to API employee workflows, particularly job title management and access control.

methods.name: AdminCanCreateJobTitle_ThenListReturnsData
methods.description: Test that an admin can create a job title via API and the list API returns data including the new entry.

methods.name: UnauthenticatedRequest_IsForbiddenOrUnauthorized
methods.description: Test that unauthenticated requests to the API are either forbidden or unauthorized, validating access control behavior.
